scope: observations from this task; synthetic channel tests are kept separate from Minecraft runtime claims
vulnerability_mechanism: The LZ4 frame header declares the decompressed length used for allocation before frame decompression.

reachability_levels.claim: Vulnerable dependency appears in a manifest or server bundle
reachability_levels.evidence: Retained source-bound manifests show the vulnerable Netty families; the 1.19 client manifest and server bundle were targeted and hash-revalidated.

reachability_levels.claim: Dependency JAR exists on the supported runtime's disk
reachability_levels.evidence: Official artifact bytes were fetched and checked for source revalidation and synthetic tests; no Minecraft launcher library directory was inspected.

reachability_levels.claim: Dependency JAR is selected on an actual launched process classpath
reachability_levels.evidence: No Minecraft client, Fabric client, or dedicated server process was launched.

reachability_levels.claim: Vulnerable decoder class is loaded by a Minecraft process
reachability_levels.evidence: Loaded-class controls observed LZ4 only in four synthetic Netty JVMs.

reachability_levels.claim: Decoder is instantiated by a Minecraft process
reachability_levels.evidence: The only decoder instances constructed were synthetic test controls.

reachability_levels.claim: Decoder is installed in a Minecraft channel pipeline
reachability_levels.evidence: Pipeline add/remove hooks passed synthetic controls; no real game channel was observed.
No Minecraft pipeline, remote peer, protocol framing, authentication phase, or input source was captured. No socket was opened by synthetic tests.

reachability_levels.claim: The vulnerable declared-length condition can occur in a supported Minecraft configuration
reachability_levels.evidence: No malicious or oversized frame was sent. No game-level, per-channel, aggregate, or pre-authentication resource limit was measured.

reachability_levels.claim: A compatible verified remediation is available for a supported game line
reachability_levels.evidence: Upstream fixed candidates passed isolated pipeline instrumentation controls, but Minecraft/Fabric ABI and supported-JVM runtime compatibility remain untested.

retained_static_scope.minecraft_26_1_2: Static disassembly records Minecraft CompressionDecoder using java.util.zip.Inflater. This is not a running-pipeline observation.
retained_static_scope.non_netty_literal_callers: No caller found in the selected static search; reflection, agents, mods, or dynamically built pipelines are not excluded.
retained_static_scope.limits: No supported runtime limit or aggregate memory bound is established by this task.

conclusion: No supported configuration can be classified at the loaded-class, decoder-installation, untrusted-input, or vulnerable-condition levels. Keep the LZ4 occurrences release-blocking pending captured supported-runtime pipeline and input-boundary evidence.
